item.title: Broken Roof Tiles: Signs, Causes and Repair Options
item.description: Short answer: a broken, cracked or slipped tile can often be addressed with a local repair, subject to its condition and the surrounding roof details. Ellis checks the tile profile, overlap, position, neighbouring tiles, ridge and flashing details before confirming the scope. Record visible damage from ground level and leave roof access to the team.

item.title: Ridge Capping: When to Repoint or Re-bed
item.description: Short answer: cracked pointing may need repointing when the bedding and caps remain sound; loose caps or failed bedding need the support assessed first. Ellis checks both layers and nearby roof details before confirming the repair. Do not climb onto the roof to test a cap or scrape mortar.

item.title: Why Gutters Overflow: Causes, Checks and Maintenance
item.description: Overflow is a drainage symptom, not automatically proof that rain has entered through the roof. A clear, methodical inspection helps separate a blocked gutter or downpipe from a roof-covering issue, so the next repair decision is based on evidence rather than guesswork.

item.title: Roof Restoration vs Replacement Adelaide
item.description: Roof restoration vs repair in Adelaide is a decision about scope: repair a defined defect, restore a wider roof area where the system supports the work, or assess replacement where deterioration is extensive. “Restoration” is often used as a broad description, but it should not be a default answer to every roof concern. Ellis defines the right scope from the roof material, component condition, water-entry source and expected outcome, not simply the roof’s age from the street.
